items.title: Ray Lopez Interview, 1958-08-30
items.q: Texas Tommy and... It all came in different categories.

ctx.x: Would the two step or the one step be called the Foxtrot mostly? The two step. The two step is the... The Foxtrot. Foxtrot tempo. And the bunny hug and all that. Yeah.
Texas Tommy and... It all came in different categories. Yeah.
Yeah, that's interesting. There's different dance steps. But you did play parades in Mardi Gras Day and all those out on the... Oh, yeah.
